content:
Donald Trump’s Department of Education delivered a self-own for the ages on Saturday after trying to ride the “Grand Theft Auto VI” hype train to promote the president’s anti-transgender agenda.

In a post to X, the department shared a screenshot from Google showing “can boys play in girls sports in...” in the search bar and the following AI overview answer below it: “No, ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ does not feature gender-segregated sports leagues where a male character can join a girls’ team.”

“If it’s not allowed in Vice City, it shouldn’t be allowed here,” the post’s caption read.

Let’s read it again.

The game DOES NOT FEATURE such leagues.

In fact, there’s no joinable sports leagues whatsoever in the game, which features the first nonbinary character in the franchise’s history — Cygnus — voiced by trans actor Jesse James Rose.

Trump signed an executive order early in his second term aimed at barring trans girls from competing in girls’ sports. And Republicans flopped in the midterms after gambling big on anti-trans messaging and attack ads despite polling showing Americans didn’t see policies tied to trans people as a leading issue on the ballot.

The post was ratio’d by several users on social media, including by constitutional law professor Anthony Michael Kreis on X who simply wrote, “There’s a literacy crisis at DoE.”

Others delivered similar takes.

“You have to imagine at some point these people would feel some kind of shame of regularly being caught not being able to process a single full sentence,” wrote another.

Others questioned why the administration was leaning into the trans youth in sports debate, including liberal commentator Adam Mockler.

“young men shifted 40 points to the left and they still think shoving culture wars down our throats will work?” Mockler wrote.
